name:        useAnimatedLayout
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Returns a handle to pass to a component whose size changes, such as TreeList or Collapsible. When that component changes size, it and the content after it inside `containerRef` animate together on one shared motion role. Fixed and stuck sticky elements stay put, the glide never scrolls the area, and Reduce Motion is respected. It applies under every pointer, a mouse included. Without the handle a component keeps its jump: content after it takes its place at once. Content after the change may mix Astryx components and your own elements; none of it opts in.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useAnimatedLayout
